description: List or execute named stock-screen starting points: profitable value, dividend income, growth and cash flow, cash generators, or dividend growth. Every preset discloses exact thresholds, units, annual lookback and sorting and runs the existing backend screener rule engine. These are mechanical screens, not recommendations or replications of a famous investor's strategy. Listing presets makes no backend request. Read-only; running a screen uses the API's metered screening budget. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

action.description: list shows exact rules without running a screen; run executes one named preset.

countries.description: Exact stored country names. Empty means all covered countries.

lookback.description: Annual observations requested. Growth uses available adjacent segments, not CAGR; missing segments are skipped by the backend.

preset.description: Required for run. For custom thresholds, copy the returned screen_stocks arguments and edit them.
